original_description: Incarn turns old photos into short, lifelike videos. Attach a family photo (or paste a public image URL) and the AI adds subtle, natural motion — gentle blinks, a faint smile, soft breathing. Made for old family and ancestor portraits. Prepaid credits, HD result, with a before/after preview right in the chat.
summary_ja: 古い家族写真や肖像写真にまばたきなどの動きを加え、短い動画にする。
limitations: 前払いクレジットを使用するとの説明。実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
